wrapper_source.source_text: const p=load("activePlan");const rows=await Promise.allSettled(p.calls.map(async c=>{const dispatch_at=new Date().toISOString();try{const result=await tools[c.tool](c.args);return {id:c.id,dispatch_at,returned_at:new Date().toISOString(),result};}catch(e){return {id:c.id,dispatch_at,returned_at:new Date().toISOString(),error:String(e)};}}));store(p.id,rows);for(const x of rows){const v=x.value;if(!v){text(x);continue;}store(v.id,v);const s=v.result?.structuredContent;text({id:v.id,dispatch_at:v.dispatch_at,returned_at:v.returned_at,isError:v.result?.isError,error:v.error,sha:s?.sha,data:s?.content?.length>0?{length:s.content.length,stored:true}:s||v.result});}
